blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose a new paradigm in wildfire management for detecting both visible and obscured fire using Deep Learning (DL). The essence of our method is the joint spatial and temporal analysis of RGB videos, embracing the fact that temporal patterns of smoke motions in consecutive video frames can indicate obscured fire flames. This perspective contrasts the traditional approach of independently analyzing images and individual video frames. To this end, we propose a frame-wise transformer architecture that applies an attention mechanism between the consecutive frames while preserving spatial information within frames as opposed to regular attention mechanisms like the non-local block, which combines spatial and temporal information into a single vector. We also optimize the temporal pattern lengths under different spatial resolutions to achieve the highest performance while reducing the computational cost. To investigate the applicability of our method in aerial image processing, we applied it to a curated version of the FLAME2 dataset that includes dual-mode RGB/IR videos. The IR video feed is used to extract ground truth, while the model is trained only on RGB videos to maintain applicability to lowcost commercial drones (which are equipped only with regular cameras) and facilitate processing existing RGB-only datasets. Our proposed method achieves a Segmentation Foreground Dice score of 92.61%, an Object Detection Precision and Recall rate of 93.21% and 91.73%, and clip-level classification accuracy of 98.02%, respectively. We also investigated the efficacy and generalizability of our method through ablation study
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了一种野火管理的新模式,用以利用"深度学习"(DL)探测出可见和隐蔽的火灾. 我们的方法的实质是对RGB视频进行空间和时间的联合分析,其中包含一个事实,即连续视频帧中烟雾运动的时间规律可以表明模糊的火焰. 这种视角与独立分析图像和个人视频帧的传统方法形成对比. 为此,我们建议采用帧式变压器架构,在相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相 我们还优化不同空间分辨率下的时间图案长度,以达到最高性能,同时降低计算成本. 为了调查我们的方法在航空图像处理中的可应用性,我们把它应用到FLAME2数据集的被整理版本中,其中包括了双模RGB/IR视频. IR视频提供用于取出地面真相,而该模型仅接受RGB视频培训,以保持对低成本商业无人机(仅配备了常规相机)的可适用性并方便处理现有的RGB-仅限数据集. 我们提出的方法实现了分层前笛分数92.61%,对象检测精度和召回率分别为93.21%和91.73%,剪接级分类精度为98.02%. 我们还通过消毒研究研究了我们方法的功效和通俗性

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Wildfires have become prevalent and destructive in many parts of the world. Regardless of the cause, wildfires can have severe consequences, including the loss of human lives, destruction of property, disruption of wildlife, food production, and crop supply chain as well as significant environmental damage. Once a wildfire starts, there are various ways to monitor and control these wildfires, including observation towers, direct human intervention, satellite imaging, and manned aircraft. Using drones is one of the most efficient ways of fire monitoring due to its low operation cost, customizable sensing and imaging, flexible operation, and ease of use in harsh environments by advanced flight control features and partial autonomy (e.g., safe auto-landing).
blocks.zh: 野火在世界许多地方已变得普遍并具有破坏性。 无论原因如何,野火都可能产生严重后果,包括人命损失、财产被破坏、野生生物被破坏、粮食生产和作物供应链被破坏以及环境被严重破坏等。 一旦一起野火开始,就有各种方法来监测和控制这些野火,包括观测塔,人类直接干预,卫星成像,和载人飞机. 使用无人驾驶飞机是监测火灾的最有效方式之一,因为它的操作成本低、可定制的感知和成像、灵活的操作,以及由于先进的飞行控制特性和部分自主性(例如安全自动着陆)而在恶劣环境中易于使用。

blocks.en: One of the most significant advantages of using drones in wildfire fighting is the ability of gathering real-time data about the fire’s behavior. Equipped with cameras and other sensors, drones can fly over the fire and capture relevant information. Drones can also be equipped with water tanks or fire extinguishers containing fire-retardant chemicals, such as carbon dioxide (CO2), potassium bicarbonate (KHCO3), or evaporating like bromochlorodifluoromethane (CF2ClBr) to be dropped on hot spots to create fire breaks. The efficient utilization of drones will significantly advance controlling these fires.
blocks.zh: 在野火战斗中使用无人机最显著的优势之一是能够收集火灾行为的实时数据. 配备有相机和其他传感器的无人机可以飞过火灾并获取相关信息. 无人机还可以装有储水箱或灭火器,内有阻火化学物质,如二氧化碳(CO2),双碳酸钾(KHCO3)等,或像溴氯二氟甲烷(CF2ClBr)等蒸发物被投放到热点上以产生火灾. 有效利用无人机将大大推进这些火灾的控制。

blocks.en: Targeting places where actual burning is happening, instead of blindly spraying fire retardant gases everywhere, will help set these fires off quickly and efficiently. Finding out these burning places in real-time is very difficult, especially when fire flames are obscured by thick smoke. An infrared camera can help find these hidden fires, but IR cameras are expensive when utilized on a large scale.
blocks.zh: 瞄准实际正在燃烧的地方,而不是盲目向各地喷洒阻燃气体,将有助于迅速而有效地点燃这些火灾。 找到这些实时燃烧的地方是非常困难的,特别是在火花被浓烟所遮蔽的时候. 红外相机可以帮助找到这些隐藏的起火,但大规模地使用IR相机时价格昂贵.

blocks.en: We devised a methodology that uses an RGB camera feed, analyzes the video frames sequentially, and detects the obscured fires using temporal features, such as smoke patterns. We show that such features can be indicative of the fire’s exact location and temporal behavior. We formulated the problem as a semantic segmentation of the obscured fire by analyzing the sequence of frames in the video.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一种方法,使用RGB相机的相机反馈,相继分析视频帧,并利用烟雾图案等时间特征探测出模糊的火灾. 说明火灾的确切地点和时间行为。 我们通过分析视频中帧的顺序,将问题发展成模糊火的语义分解.

blocks.en:
We propose a deep learning architecture, ‘Frame-Wise Transformer,’ that utilizes a pre-trained CNN backbone to extract the features from video frames and passes through a convolutional transformer that aggregates the video features and sends them to a decoder, which will predict the segmentation map of the fire flames. We have implemented a convolutional transformer mimicking the NLP transformer, treating the video frame features as word embedding. Utilizing the popular non-local block [ 1 ] for attention mechanism did not yield reasonable results. Therefore, we re-formulated the attention mechanism to restrict attention only between frames while not mixing within the frame information.
We modified the non-local block accordingly and achieved a significant performance gain. To balance the spatial resolution and temporal depth, we examined different frame rates while aggregating features at different resolutions. We observed that using more frames at lower resolutions provides higher performance while reducing the computation cost compared to using equal depth at all resolutions. The overall design can be extended to other video-based deep-learning tasks by making minor modifications to accommodate task-specific requirements.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个深层的学习架构“Frame-Wise Transformer ”(Frame-Wise Transformer), 利用经过预先训练的CNN主干线从视频帧中取出功能, 并通过一个将视频功能集成并发送到解码器的转录器, 我们实施了一个模仿NLP变压器的回转式变压器,把视频帧的功能当作是文字嵌入. 利用受欢迎的非当地区块[1]作为注意机制没有产生合理结果。 因此,我们重新形成了注意机制,只限制帧之间的注意,而不在帧信息内混合.
我们相应修改了非本地区块,取得了显著的绩效收益. 为了平衡空间分辨率和时间深度,我们在汇总不同分辨率的特征时审查了不同的帧率。 我们注意到,在较低分辨率下使用更多框架可提高性能,同时降低计算成本,而不是在所有分辨率下使用同等深度。 整体设计可以通过进行小的修改来适应特定任务的要求来被扩展至其他基于视频的深层学习任务.

blocks.en: To this end, we curated a dataset from the existing FLAME2 [ 2 ] dataset by selecting part of video frames from the original data where the drone is stationary, and there is high synchronization with the IR images to avoid misalignment errors. We also use the corresponding IR videos to extract ground truth for our task by performing a series of image-processing operations. We have visually verified the correspondence of RGB video with the processed IR video for frame-level synchronization.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们从现有的FLAME2[2]数据集中,通过从无人机静止位置的原始数据中选择了部分视频帧来对数据集进行整理,并与IR图像高度同步来避免错配出错. 我们还通过进行一系列图像处理操作,利用相应的IR视频为我们的任务取出地面真相. 我们已经目视地核实了RGB视频与经过处理的IR视频的通信,用于帧级同步.

blocks.en: The rest of the paper is organized as follows. We highlight the unique features of our method compared to previous methods in Section 2, then proceed by elaborating on the details of the generated dataset and its preparation method in Sections 3 and 4.1. We then elucidate the details of the proposed deep learning (DL) architecture in Section Section 4.2. The obtained results are investigated in Section 5, followed by concluding remarks in Section 6.
blocks.zh: 本文其余部分编排如下. 我们强调我们的方法与第2节以前的方法相比的独特性,然后在第3和4.1节阐述生成数据集的细节及其编制方法。 然后,我们在第4.2节中阐述拟议的深入学习架构的细节。 第5节对所得结果进行调查,后在第6节作总结发言。

blocks.en: II Related work
blocks.zh: 二. 有关工作

blocks.en:
The previous works on fire detection are mainly based on image-based techniques such as classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation of visible fire imagery. Wonjae Lee et al. proposed a wildfire detection system that classifies the presence of fire in images and evaluated the performance of AlexNet, GoogLeNet, and VGG, along with their modified variants [ 3 ] . Zhentian et al. have trained YOLOV3 for fire detection and reported a recognition rate of 91% [ 4 ] . An ensemble-based object detection method using YOLOV5 EfficientDet is proposed in [ 5 ] for detection and EfficientNet to capture global information about the fire. Their study showed a decrease in false positive rate by 51.3% on public datasets. Yo Zhao et al. have proposed a deep learning architecture, called Fire-Net by stacking convolutional and pooling layers for fast localization and segmentation of fire in aerial images with an accuracy of 98 % on standard ’UAV_Fire’ dataset [ 6 ] . A similar method is proposed in [ 7 ] and [ 8 ] by using a deep learning architecture to classify frames into ”fire with smoke”, ”fire with no smoke”, and ”no fire” using FLAME datasets [ 2 , 9 ] . However, most of these methods are limited to images, whereas real-time data for fire detection will be mostly in terms of video feed. Further, they ignore the fact that video feeds contain temporal patterns of smoke that can help locate the origin of smoke or equivalently the fire spots. Temporal analysis of such patterns, especially in the presence of clouds and other white patterns, can be extremely useful for precise fire detection.
This concept is used as a key idea in our method to detect obscured fire positions.
blocks.zh:
之前的活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活 元载 Lee等提出了野火探测系统,该系统将图像中火的存在分类,并评价了AlexNet,GoogleNet,和VGG的性能,连同其被修改的变体[3]. Zhentian等人对YOLOV3进行了火灾探测培训,并报告说识别率为91% [4]. 在[5]中,提议采用基于综艺的物体探测方法,使用YOLOV5 高效Det,用于探测和高效Net,以获取关于火灾的全球信息。 他们的研究表明,公共数据集的假正率下降了51.3%。 于赵等. 提出一个深层的学习架构, 叫做Fire-Net, 在[7]和[8]中提出了类似的方法,方法是使用深层学习架构将框架分类为“有烟的火”、“无烟的火”和“无烟的火”使用FLAME数据集[2,9]。 然而,这些方法大多仅限于图像,而用于火灾探测的实时数据将主要通过视频提供. 此外,它们忽略了这样一个事实,即视频素材含有时间性的烟雾模式,有助于确定烟雾的来源,或者相当于火点。 对这种模式进行时间分析,特别是在有云和其他白色模式存在的情况下,对于精确的火灾探测可能极为有用.
这一概念被作为我们探测模糊的火力位置的方法中的一个关键概念.

blocks.en: Some works take a slightly different approach and analyze fire image patch by patch instead of one-shot analysis of the entire image. For instance, a CNN-based deep learning method is proposed in [ 10 ] which classifies the image first and then performs a patch-level analysis to offer more detailed information. They applied their method to video frames and performed patch-wise detection. They reported a 97 % detection accuracy on their own dataset. Still, this method does not consider the temporal relationships for fire classification since it treats the video frame as a sequence of independent still images. In a similar work, Gwangsu Kim et al [ 11 ] . proposed an algorithm that collects features of video frames using a pre-trained VGG and stacks them together to be passed through a series of fully connected layers to classify the presence of fire in the video clips. However, this method which restricts fire classification only during a visible fire deemed inefficient in capturing obscured fire.
blocks.zh: 有些作品采用稍有不同的方法,用补丁来分析火影像补丁,而不是对整个影像进行一发分析. 例如,在[10]中提出了一个基于CNN的深度学习方法,这种方法首先对图像进行分类,然后进行补丁级分析,以提供更详细的信息. 他们将方法应用于视频帧,并进行了补丁检测. 他们自报数据集检测精度为97%. 然而,这种方法并不考虑火灾分类的时间关系,因为它将视频帧视为独立的静态图像的序列. 相类似的作品中,光秀·金等 [11]. . 提出一种算法,使用预先训练的VGG来收集视频帧的特征,并把它们堆放在一起来通过一系列完全连接的地层来分类视频剪辑中存在的火. 然而,这种方法只在可见的火灾中限制火的分级,认为在捕捉隐蔽火力方面没有效率。

blocks.en: Anshuman et al. [ 12 ] have proposed SmokeyNet - a deep learning algorithm that offers stacking CNN, LSTM, and Vision Transformer to detect smoke in the video feed captured by stand-alone cameras. However, this method is not directly applicable to aerial imagery. Some other research works take advantage of Infra-Red (IR) cameras for more accurate fire positioning. For instance, Chi Yuan et al. proposed an algorithm that uses brightness and motion clues with histogram-based segmentation and optical flow to segment fire in IR images [ 13 ] . Another example is Norsuzial et al.’s work that offers an Image processing-based approach to convert IR images to YCbCr color and use a wavelet analyzer to detect fire [ 14 ] . Also, a DL architecture is proposed in [ 15 ] that analyzes dual-feed imagery captured by side-by-side RGB and IR cameras for precise fire positioning.
blocks.zh: Anshuman等 [12] 提出了SmokeyNet - 一个深层学习算法,提供堆叠CNN,LSTM,和Vision Transformer,以探测被独立相机捕获的视频信号中的烟. 然而,这种方法并不直接适用于航空图像. 其他一些研究工作利用Infra-Red (IR)相机进行更精确的火力定位. 例如,Chi Yuan等提出了一种算法,利用光亮度和运动线索,在IR图像中以直方图为基础的分块和光学流向分块起火[13]。 另一个例子是Norsuzial et al.的作品,它提供了一种基于图像处理的方法,将IR图像转换为YCbCr颜色,并使用波浪分析器来探测起火 [14]. 另外,在 [15] 中还提出了DL架构,用于分析由相邻RGB和IR相机所捕获的双向图像,以精确地进行消防定位.

blocks.en:
Although these methods yield high accuracy taking advantage of thermal information captured by IR cameras, they incur an extra monitoring cost for their reliance on pricey IR cameras. Also, they are not suitable for processing existing drone-based and satellite-based datasets that include only RGB imagery.
In contrast to these works, our method uses only RGB videos for detecting both visible and obscured fire flames in an economical way.
blocks.zh:
虽然这些方法利用IR相机所捕获的热能信息获得很高的准确性,但由于它们依赖价格昂贵的IR相机而引起额外的监测费用. 此外,它们也不适合处理仅包括RGB图像的现有无人机和卫星数据集。
与这些作品不同,我们的方法仅使用RGB视频,以经济的方式探测可见和模糊的火焰.

blocks.en: III Data Preparation
blocks.zh: 页:1 数据编制

blocks.en: We investigated different fire datasets and found out that FLAME2 dataset [ 2 ] provides the most suitable testing condition because it has videos consisting of visible and obscured fire regions with smoke. Also, it offers a dual mode RGB/IR imagery that simplifies evaluating the proposed framework.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了不同的火灾数据集,发现FLAME2数据集[2]提供了最合适的测试条件,因为它的视频由有烟雾的可见而模糊的火灾区域组成. 此外,它还提供了一个双重模式RGB/IR图像,简化了对拟议框架的评价。

blocks.en: FLAME2 consists of seven pairs of lengthy RGB and IR video feeds taken by seven drones equipped with side-by-side RGB/IR cameras. The videos were taken from a prescribed fire region in Kaibab National forest in Northern Arizona. For experimentation purposes, we have carefully cropped the parts of the video where the camera is relatively stationary and there is a high alignment between the RGB and IR camera viewpoints, so IR stands as a legitimate ground truth. The selected video segments are split into clips of 20 consecutive frames to train our deep neural network, where each clip is considered a training sample. In total, we have used 839 video samples for training(594) and evaluating(255) our method. These video samples consist of a diverse set of positive samples consisting of visible and obscured fire regions shot at different locations and negative samples where fire is absent, which are included to make the model robust.
blocks.zh: FLAME2由7对长长的RGB和IR视频素材组成,由7架配备相机并肩的RGB/IR相机所拍摄. 影片取自亚利桑那州北部凯巴布国家森林处所划定的消防区. 为了实验的目的,我们仔细地裁剪了相机相对固定的相机部分,并且RGB和IR相机的相机观点高度一致,因此IR站立为合法的地基真理. 所选择的视频片段被分为连续20帧的片段来训练我们的深层神经网络,每个片段都被认为是训练样本. 我们总共使用839个录像样本进行培训(594个)和评价(255个)我们的方法。 这些视频样本包括一组多样的阳性样本,包括在不同地点射入的可见和模糊的火区和没有起火的阴性样本,这些样本都是为了使模型坚固而列入的.

blocks.en: IV Method
blocks.zh: 四. 方法

blocks.en: IV-A Data Pre-Processing: IR to RGB Labels
blocks.zh: 数据 处理前: IR 到 RGB 标签

blocks.en: The IR images consist of heat maps corresponding to the temperature of different regions on the image. The place where the fire is present generally has a higher temperature, and the pixel values in the heat map are closer to the maximum. We have extracted the ground truth for training data where the fire is present by processing the IR image with a series of hand-crafted image processing methods. The sequence of operations performed on the IR image is presented below.
blocks.zh: IR图像由对应图像上不同区域温度的热图所组成. 火灾发生地的温度一般较高,热图中的像素值更接近最大. 我们通过使用一系列手工制作的图像处理方法处理IR图像,提取出地面真相,用于培训火所存在的数据。 下面介绍IR图像上的操作顺序.

blocks.en: We initially smooth out the image and reduce the noise level using a low-pass filter, then use hard thresholding to select the regions of high-temperature values corresponding to fire. The resulting image is dilated to fill in the small spaces and make the fire boundary smooth; the spaces not filled in the previous operations are filled using flood fill, resulting in a complete blob of fire location. The image is eroded to compensate for the effect of dilation applied earlier. Finally, the small blobs that are likely to be representative of noise are removed. The extracted ground truth can been seen in Fig. 2

Note that we use IR images to identify ground truth fire locations when training the model, but in runtime (new monitoring tasks), we only use RGB images, so our method does not require expensive IR cameras on site.
We treat each video clip with 20 frames as a sample and use the obtained ground-truth binary fire map from the last IR frame as our reference for the entire clip.

请注意,在训练模型时,我们使用IR图像来识别地面真火地点,但在运行时(新的监测任务),我们只使用RGB图像,因此我们的方法不需要现场昂贵的IR相机.

blocks.en: IV-B Deep Learning Architecture
blocks.zh: 四-B 深层学习结构

blocks.en: The proposed deep Learning architecture ‘Frame-wise Transformer’ comprises three stages, as shown in Fig. 1 . The first stage involves extracting features from the individual frames, which is done using a pre-trained encoder. Here, we used VGG-16 [ 16 ] . The next stage focuses on aggregating the sequential features of the video frames with a convolutional transformer; we have considered utilizing features at different stages of the encoder as followed in standard semantic segmentation architectures like U-net [ 17 ] . Furthermore, we have examined different frame rates at different resolutions for aggregation to obtain the most efficient architecture to exploit temporal relations. The later stage consists of a decoding network with a series of convolutional and upsampling blocks that combine information at different resolutions to obtain the segmentation map.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,拟议的深层学习架构`Frame-wise-transformer ' 包括三个阶段。 第一阶段涉及从单个帧中取出特征,使用经过预先训练的编码器来完成. 在这里,我们使用了VGG-16 [16]. 下阶段的重点是将相继的视频帧特征用回旋变压器来汇总;我们考虑在编码器的不同阶段采用U-net等标准语义分解架构所遵循的特征[17]. 此外,我们审查了不同决议的不同框架费率,以便汇总,获得利用时间关系的最有效结构。 后期由解码网络组成,并有一系列的分解和取样块,将不同分辨率的信息相融合以得到分解图.

blocks.en: IV-C Convolutional Transformer
blocks.zh: 四-C 革命变革者

blocks.en: We have formulated a convolutional transformer inspired by the transformer [ 18 ] in Natural Language Processing by treating each frame of the video as a word and feature map from the encoder as word embedding and feature maps of a series of frames as a series of word embeddings. Multiple feature maps from the encoder can be equivalent to having multiple heads. These heads can be further scaled to increase the expressiveness of the features by multiplying the input channels with n n heads while projecting the input into key, query, and value maps. Then, a proposed Frame-wise attention is applied to find the relations between the frames and finally fed to a convolutional block. The overall block diagram is shown in Fig. 1 (b).
blocks.zh: 我们在"自然语言处理"中开发出由变相器[18]所启发的革命变相器,将视频的每个帧作为编码器中的单词和特征映射作为单词嵌入,将一系列帧的特征映射作为一串单词嵌入. 来自编码器的多功能地图可以等同拥有多头. 这些头可以被进一步缩放,通过将输入通道与n头相乘,同时将输入投射到密钥,查询和值图中来增加特征的表达性. 然后,采用拟议框架的注意来发现框架之间的关系,最后输入一个演变块。 图1(b)显示了总体块图。

blocks.en: We have employed residual connections and normalization around each of the sublayers, and we have chosen batch normalization instead of layer normalization, which is usually preferred in CNNs. Positional embeddings were added to the extracted video features before the convolutional projection.
blocks.zh: 我们使用残余的连接 和正常化 围绕每一个子层, 我们选择了批量的正常化 而不是层层正常化, 这通常在CNNs中更可取。 在演化投影前被取出视频功能中加入了位置嵌入.

blocks.zh: 四-C 1 革命投影

blocks.zh: IV-C 2 自我关注

blocks.en:
The scaled dot product provides attention to features across the frames. Initially, we tried the attention computation using the non-local block published in [ 1 ] , which models space-time attention by flattening all the features into one single vector and performing the dot product and subsequent matrix multiplication,
as shown in Eq. ( 2 ). However, this method mixes up the information in space and time causing ambiguity in distinguishing information between space and time. In the NLP universe, one can imagine this operation as finding attention within the word embedding while finding attention with other words.
Therefore, we have modified the computation by providing attention between the frames but not within the frame, which finds relations between the frames while separating within the frame information. The proposed attention mechanism and its distinction with non-local attention are presented in Fig. 3 .
The modified attention mechanism can be expressed as Frame-Wise Attention ​ ( Q , K , V ) \displaystyle\text{Frame-Wise Attention}(Q,K,V) = \displaystyle= softmax ​ ( Q ( C × T × H ​ W ) ⋅ K ( C × T × H ​ W ) T d k ) ⋅ V ( C × T × H ​ W ) \displaystyle\hskip-130.0002pt\text{softmax}\left(\frac{Q_{(C\times T\times HW)}\cdot K_{(C\times T\times HW)}^{T}}{\sqrt{d_{k}}}\right)\cdot V_{(C\times T\times HW)} (3)

blocks.zh: IV-C 3 无地貌结合

blocks.en: Post the attention operation, unlike the NLP transformer, where the output of multiple heads is concatenated and averaged out, we have used a convolutional block to reduce the number of multi-headed self-attention feature maps to the original input number.

blocks.en: IV-D Frame Rate Variation
blocks.zh: IV-D 框架率变化

blocks.en: We have developed a technique for varying frame rates based on principles of natural eyesight physics. Essentially, when objects are far away, they appear smaller, and the entire scene is visible, whereas when objects are closer, only parts of the scene are visible. Leveraging this concept, we have explored two theories. The first is to use all the frame features of low resolution from the encoder and lower the use of the number of frame features in the previous higher resolutions at a chosen frame rate. The second theory inverts the first theory by using more frames at higher resolution and fewer frames at lower resolution. We got the best results using the first theory, which aligns with our eyesight-based principle, with a significant margin in computational gain compared to the second theory. The results are discussed in Section 5.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一种基于自然视力物理原理的不同帧率技术. 本质上,当物体距离较远时,它们显得更小,整个场景可见;而当物体靠近时,只有部分场景可见. 我们利用这一概念,探索了两个理论。 第一种是使用编码器中低分辨率的所有帧特性,并用所选择的帧速率来降低以前更高分辨率中帧特性数量的使用. 第二个理论通过在更高分辨率时使用更多的帧来倒置第一个理论,而更低分辨率时使用更少的帧. 我们利用第一个理论获得了最佳结果,这个理论与我们基于视力的原则是一致的,与第二个理论相比,计算收益的幅度很大. 第5节讨论了结果。

blocks.zh: 四-E 损失函数

blocks.en: We have used Dice loss [ 20 ] to measure the alignment between the ground truth and the detected fire regions by the architecture to train the network. The Dice coefficient measures the alignment (similarity) between two corresponding segments by computing the overlap coefficient. The overlap coefficient ranges from 0 to 1, with 1 indicating a perfect match between the two segments. blocks.en: V Experiments
blocks.zh: 五. 实验

blocks.en:
In this section, we present the simulation results using the FLAME2 dataset, which consists of RGB and IR images; we have trained with pre-processed videos as explained in the Data Preparation step. We have used 594 videos for training and 255 videos for testing. Out of these, 354 of training and 155 of testing are positive examples, consisting of visible and obscure fire regions, and the rest are negative videos with no fire locations.
All the training and testing videos are independent and include no overlapping frames.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们使用FLAME2数据集来介绍模拟结果,该数据集由RGB和IR图像组成;我们接受了数据准备步骤中解释的预处理视频培训. 我们使用594个视频进行培训,使用255个视频进行测试。 其中,354个培训单位和155个测试单位为阳性实例,包括可见和模糊的火灾区域,其余为没有起火地点的负面视频.
所有培训和测试视频都是独立的,没有重叠的帧.

blocks.en: V-A Training
blocks.zh: V-A 培训

blocks.en:
Our model is implemented in PyTorch lightning [ 17 ] using a single node Linux machine with 2 Tesla A-100 40 GB GPUs.
The models were tuned for the best hyperparameters. We used a step-learning rate with an initial learning rate of 2e-4 with Adam Optimizer [ 21 ] . The models were trained for 150 epochs with early stopping and a batch size of 2.
blocks.zh:
我们的模型在PyTorch闪电[17]中被实施,使用单节点Linux机,有2个Tesla A-100 40 GB GPU.
这些模型被调制成最好的超参数。 我们使用了一个分步学习率,初始学习率为2e-4,与亚当·优化[21]. 这些模型为150个世纪的早期停站和2个分批规模的培训。

blocks.en: V-B Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: V-B 评价计量

blocks.en: We are using a set of metrics to evaluate the quality of fire detection. We used the Fore Ground Dice score (presented in Eq. ( 5 )) to assess the alignment quality between ground truth and the detected fire region. This assessment is particularly important when part of the fire is obscured by thick smoke to demonstrate how capable our model is in detecting such fire regions.
blocks.zh: 我们正在使用一套衡量标准来评估火灾探测的质量。 我们利用地底地虱分数(在Eq.(5)中介绍)来评估地面真理与被探测到的火灾区域之间的校正质量。 当部分火灾被浓烟所掩盖时,这种评估特别重要,以表明我们的模型在探测这种火灾区域方面有多大的能力。

blocks.en: Another metric we used is blob-wise object detection F1 score Eq. ( 7 ), which is the harmonic mean of precision and recall Eq. ( 6 ) to ensure the correctness of our predictions; it is calculated by taking each blob in the ground truth and prediction, and if the intersection area is greater than 50%, considering it as a True Positive, else a False Positive.

Also, we calculate clip-level classification accuracy to obtain clip-level labels, Fire and No-Fire. This is calculated by counting the number of fire spots in the video and comparing it with the prediction;
if more than 50% of spots are predicted, we will classify the video as Fire; otherwise, No-Fire.

如果预言超过50%的斑点,我们会将视频归类为"火";否则,"不放火".

blocks.en: V-C 1 Thresholds
blocks.zh: V-C 1 阈值

blocks.en:
The thresholds are the values that indicate the percentage of frames used in the subsequent resolution starting with a use of 100% frames. For example, in Low Res., if the value is α = 0.9 \alpha=0.9 , at resolution (H x W)/16 which is the lowest, 100% of the frames will be used, and in the subsequent resolution (HxW)/8, 90% of the frames (the most recent ones) will be used and again in the next resolution 90% of the remaining frames in the previous resolution will be used ( α 2 = 0.9 × 0.9 \alpha^{2}=0.9\times 0.9 ) and so on. Therefore, the number of frames at each layer follows exponential decay, layer by layer.
Likewise, for High Res. 100% of the frames will be used at the highest resolution, (HxW)/2, and the number of frames decreases, with the rate of α = 0.9 \alpha=0.9 , for the lower resolutions.
blocks.zh:
阈值是指从使用100%帧开始,在后续分辨率中使用的帧百分比的值. 例如,在"Low Res."中,如果数值为α=0.9\alpha=0.9,在分辨率(H x W)/16为最低,则100%的帧将被使用;在随后的"决议"(HxW)/8中,90%的帧(最新的帧)将被使用,在下一项决议中90%的上个决议中的剩余帧将被使用(α 2=0.9×0.9\alpha2×0.9分秒)等. 因此,每层的帧数都跟随指数衰减,逐层递减.
同样,对于高分辨率,100%的帧将在最高分辨率(HxW)/2使用,帧数会减少,而下分辨率为α=0.9\alpha=0.9。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
This work is devoted to detecting obscured fire flames by analyzing video feeds captured by drones. All existing works, to the best of our knowledge, solve fire detection through image-based segmentation and object-detection methods. This neglects the fact that temporal analysis of video frames can recover motion patterns of smoke that can be indicative of obscured fire flames. Therefore, existing work fails to recover fire flames obscured by smoke patterns. To address this matter, we developed a novel architecture based on the frame-wise convolutional transformer that uses between-frame attention to capture relationships between frames to help locate obscured fire flames.
We investigated the trade-off between feature resolution and temporal depth and observed that it is advantageous to use a higher depth for lower resolution, and lower depth for higher resolution. This reflects the fact that long-term motions can be captured in low-resolution feature spaces. Applying our model to FLAME2 datasets resulted in almost full success in clip-level fire classification while achieving about Dice score of 92.6%, and precision and recall scores of 93.2% and 91.73% in detecting fire flames. Our ablation study shows that our proposed attention mechanism outperformed the well-known non-local block with more than 7% improvement in F1 score.
blocks.zh:
这项工作致力于通过分析被无人机捕获的视频信号来探测隐蔽的火焰. 所有现有的作品,就我们所知,都通过以图像为基础的分解和物体探测方法来解决火灾探测. 这忽视了这样一个事实,即对视频帧的时间分析可以恢复烟雾的运动规律,这可以表明模糊的火焰. 因此,现有工作未能恢复被烟雾模式所掩盖的火焰。 为了解决这个问题,我们开发了以帧相向的回旋变压器为基础的新建筑,利用帧相向的注意力来捕捉帧相向的关系来帮助定位模糊的火焰.
我们调查了地物分辨率与时间深度之间的取舍,认为利用更深的地物分辨率较低,而用更深的地物分辨率较高,是有利的。 这反映出长期运动可以在低分辨率地物空间被捕获. 将我们的模型应用到FLAME2数据集,在剪接级火力分级上几乎完全成功,同时在探测起火量方面达到大约92.6%的Dice分,精确和召回得分93.2%和91.73%. 我们的减肥研究显示,我们提出的关注机制的性能超过了著名的非本地区块,F1分数提升了7%以上.

blocks.en: We examined the interplay between spatial resolution and temporal depth by experimenting with various frame rates and resolutions. Our findings indicate that employing more frames at lower resolutions offers enhanced performance and computational efficiency compared to uniform depth allocation across resolutions. This versatile framework can be tailored for other video-based deep-learning tasks with slight modifications to meet specific task requirements.
blocks.zh: 我们通过试验各种帧率和分辨率,审查了空间分辨率和时间深度之间的相互作用。 我们的调查结果表明,在较低的分辨率下采用更多的框架,比在各项决议中统一进行深度分配更能提高业绩和计算效率。 这一多功能框架可以适应其他基于视频的深入学习任务,但稍作修改,以满足具体的任务要求。

blocks.en: To support our research, we curated a dataset from the FLAME2 dataset, carefully selecting video frames where the drone is stationary and synchronized with IR images to mitigate alignment discrepancies. Ground truth labels were generated using corresponding IR videos and image-processing operations. Through meticulous visual verification, we ensured frame-level synchronization between RGB and processed IR videos.
blocks.zh: 为了支持我们的研究,我们从FLAME2数据集整理出一套数据集,仔细选择无人机固定位置的视频帧,并与IR图像同步以缓解对齐差异. 地面真理标签是通过相应的IR视频和图像处理操作生成的. 通过细致的视觉核查,我们确保了RGB和已处理的IR视频之间的帧级同步.

blocks.en: In conclusion, our methodology presents a robust solution for obscured fire detection using video analysis. The ’Frame-Wise Transformer’ architecture, informed by our tailored attention mechanisms and frame aggregation strategies, showcases its potential for video-based deep learning applications.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的方法为利用视频分析进行模糊的火灾探测提供了一个强有力的解决办法。 " Frame-Wise Transformer " 架构借鉴了我们有针对性的关注机制和框架汇总战略,展示了其基于视频的深入学习应用的潜力。
